name_en: A357-T6 coupons: hot yield and fatigue
name_tr: A357-T6 numuneleri: sıcak akma ve yorulma
article: test bars cut from the first P101 / F201 castings
measured: yield at 20-350 degC (1/2 h), S-N at R = -1 and 0.1
pass_criterion_en: casting factor 1.25 and the 3.7 hot yield shown
pass_criterion_tr: 1,25 döküm katsayısı ve 3.7 sıcak akma değerleri gösterildi

article: ring segment on an A357 groove coupon, oil-wetted
measured: friction coefficient, wear

article: first P101, F201, P103, gears
measured: CMM to the 3.8 callouts, CT / RT of castings, case depth coupons, Ra
pass_criterion_en: all callouts of tolerances_v1.csv met; pores <= 0.5 mm in critical zones
pass_criterion_tr: tolerances_v1.csv'deki bütün işaretler sağlandı; kritik bölgelerde gözenek <= 0,5 mm

name_tr: Sırt sırta dişli test düzeneği (1. kademe + planet)
article: one RGB gear set in a back-to-back rig, MIL-PRF-23699
measured: strain gauges at the ring roots (load sharing), loaded TE, micropitting and scuffing inspection, losses
pass_criterion_en: K_gamma <= 1.35; TE2 <= 0.15 um; no scuffing at 110% torque; losses <= SYS-05
pass_criterion_tr: K_gamma <= 1,35; TE2 <= 0,15 um; %110 torkta tutukluk yok; kayıplar <= SYS-05

name_en: Planet bearing speed and load rig
name_tr: Planet rulmanı hız ve yük düzeneği
article: planet with its integral outer race on the M50NiL pin
measured: outer race temperature, cage slip, vibration
pass_criterion_en: no skidding damage; temperature within the 2.5 limit
pass_criterion_tr: kayma hasarı yok; sıcaklık 2.5 sınırı içinde

name_en: Static test of the cases (limit and ultimate)
article: first P101 + F201 with the mounts
measured: strain gauges at the 3.5 / 3.6 hot spots, deflection at the ring seat
pass_criterion_en: no yield at limit (LD-03 to LD-05, LD-08), no failure at 1.5 x limit; stiffness within 10% of the FE
pass_criterion_tr: sınır yükte akma yok (LD-03 - LD-05, LD-08), 1,5 x sınırda kırılma yok; direngenlik sonlu elemanın %10'u içinde

name_en: Modal tap test and damping-ring ring-down
name_tr: Modal vurma testi ve sönüm halkası sönümlenme testi
article: P101 with the ring gear, gear 2 web with and without the ring
measured: accelerometers, impact hammer
pass_criterion_en: case and web modes within 5% of 3.6; damping with the ring at or above the 3.6 value
pass_criterion_tr: gövde ve gövde-dişli modları 3.6'nın %5'i içinde; halkayla sönüm 3.6 değerinde ya da üstünde

name_tr: Aksesuar yuvası ve kesme boynu testi
article: generator pad with its quill
measured: pad torque to the shear neck, overhung moment
pass_criterion_en: shear neck fails within its band; pad holds 1.5 x limit
pass_criterion_tr: kesme boynu kendi bandında kırılır; yuva 1,5 x sınırı taşır

name_en: Fire test of F201 and the P101 / F201 joint
name_tr: F201 ve P101 / F201 birleşiminin yangın testi
article: F201 with the joint and seals, oil flowing at the lowest flow
measured: flame calibration, wall and seal temperatures, leakage
pass_criterion_en: fire resistant 5 min with no leak that feeds the fire (SAF-05)
pass_criterion_tr: 5 dk yangına dayanıklı, yangını besleyen sızıntı yok (SAF-05)

article: NJ1024 in the nose housing, push-in load
measured: outer ring thermocouples, rib wear
pass_criterion_en: carries the limp thrust (3.0 kN) to landing; thermocouple alert works
pass_criterion_tr: topal itkiyi (3,0 kN) inişe kadar taşır; termokupl uyarısı çalışır

name_tr: Yakalama dudağı sürtünme testi (4340 üzerinde Ti)
article: P116 lip segment against a 4340 collar
measured: temperature, wear depth
pass_criterion_en: lip holds the run-down and feathered drag (3.7 basis)
pass_criterion_tr: dudak, dönüp durmayı ve tüylenmiş sürüklemeyi taşır (3.7 esası)

name_en: Torque meter calibration and HUMS baseline
name_tr: Tork ölçer kalibrasyonu ve HUMS temel çizgisi
article: torque meter on a calibrated rig; HUMS on the first engine
measured: torque signal against a reference, vibration baselines
pass_criterion_en: torque error within the CTL-01 limit; HUMS baselines recorded
pass_criterion_tr: tork hatası CTL-01 sınırı içinde; HUMS temel kayıtları alındı

article: seals, breather and the nose air gap
measured: ingress, corrosion, seal leakage
pass_criterion_en: no ingress past the seals; no corrosion beyond the limits
pass_criterion_tr: keçeleri geçen giriş yok; sınırların ötesinde korozyon yok

name_en: Spline wear: crowned sun spline and accessory quills
name_tr: Kama aşınması: bombeli güneş kaması ve aksesuar milleri
article: sun quill P106 in the intermediate shaft with the 3.8 misalignment; generator quill
measured: wear depth and pattern, oil flow at the spline
pass_criterion_en: wear after the TBO equivalent within the 3.8 spline fit allowance; lubricated contact pattern
pass_criterion_tr: TBO eşdeğerinden sonra aşınma 3.8 kama geçmesi payı içinde; yağlanmış temas izi

article: engine on a water-brake dynamometer (no propeller), then with the propeller
measured: strain gauges on the case and the gear 2 web, accelerometers, speed sweep
pass_criterion_en: all stresses within the endurance limits with margin (DYN-01 to DYN-05)
pass_criterion_tr: bütün gerilmeler yorulma sınırlarının altında, payla (DYN-01 - DYN-05)

article: engine on the dynamometer
measured: torque, speed, case strain
pass_criterion_en: LD-01 transient and LD-02 over-torque run without damage; teardown clean
pass_criterion_tr: LD-01 geçici ve LD-02 aşırı tork hasarsız; sökümde temiz

article: engine on the dynamometer
measured: speeds, vibration
pass_criterion_en: 110% transient run without damage
pass_criterion_tr: %110 geçici hız hasarsız

name_en: Oil system: attitude and negative g
name_tr: Yağ sistemi: duruş açısı ve negatif g
article: RGB oil system on a tilt rig, then the engine
measured: pressures at the jets, scavenge, pitch oil pressure
pass_criterion_en: jet pressure held at the attitudes and for the negative-g time
pass_criterion_tr: duruş açılarında ve negatif g süresince meme basıncı tutuldu

name_tr: Mil kopması koruması (FADEC donanım döngüsü + motor kesme)
article: FADEC on a hardware-in-the-loop bench, then engine trips
measured: detection time, valve closure time, peak PT speed
pass_criterion_en: detection and closure within SAF-03; peak PT speed below the burst margin
pass_criterion_tr: algılama ve kapanma SAF-03 içinde; en yüksek PT hızı patlama payının altında

article: engine on the dynamometer, 150 h schedule
measured: power, losses, oil temperatures and pressures, chips, HUMS
pass_criterion_en: rated power held; oil limits met; no distress at teardown
pass_criterion_tr: anma gücü tutuldu; yağ sınırları sağlandı; sökümde hasar yok

name_en: Loss-of-oil run with the emergency mist
article: engine on the dynamometer at 75% MCP
measured: bearing and gear temperatures, mist flow
pass_criterion_en: >= 6 min at 75% MCP after total oil-pressure loss
pass_criterion_tr: toplam yağ basıncı kaybından sonra %75 MCP'de >= 6 dk

article: engine with propeller, motored by the propeller
measured: oil pressure, temperatures
pass_criterion_en: lubrication held while windmilling (intact drive chain)
pass_criterion_tr: rüzgârla dönerken yağlama sürdü (sağlam tahrik zinciri)

article: engine cold-soaked to -40 degC; altitude cell
measured: oil temperature rise, jet pressure, pump inlet pressure
pass_criterion_en: start and power within the 3.2 limits; no pump cavitation at altitude
pass_criterion_tr: kalkış ve güç 3.2 sınırları içinde; irtifada pompa kavitasyonu yok

name_tr: Tüyleme ve pervane aşırı devir regülatörü
article: engine with propeller
measured: pitch oil pressure, propeller speed, feather time
pass_criterion_en: feathers on loss of pitch oil; overspeed governor holds the limit
pass_criterion_tr: pervane yağı kaybında tüyler; aşırı devir regülatörü sınırı tutar

article: RGB modules (3.10)
measured: removal and installation times
pass_criterion_en: MNT-01 and MNT-02 met
pass_criterion_tr: MNT-01 ve MNT-02 sağlandı
